title: <study>.variants.json, version 1.0.0 (ADR 0132, Proposed; completes ADR 0130 A7)
description: The sets of one study that differ in stiffness or another parameter. This schema checks the shape of a 1.0.x file and the lexical form of each path. Rules it cannot express (unique labels and paths, the name rule's NFC test, confinement after symlinks are resolved, that the path names an existing model file) are in architecture/h5-schema.md, section '<study>.variants.json', and a reader applies them per row.

version.description: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH as a string, read by the floor rule of ADR 0113 (floor 1.0.0).

name.description: ADR 0130 A2: non-empty, no control character, no leading or trailing whitespace. NFC is checked by the reader, not here.

path.description: The variant's model file <stem>.h5, relative to the folder that holds the manifest, with / as the separator. Subfolders are allowed; no segment is empty, '.' or '..'; no backslash, colon, control character or leading slash. It ends in .h5 and is not a .geometry.h5, .results.h5 or .user.h5 sibling.

param.description: A parameter value: a string, a finite number or a boolean. No null, array or object.
